static (AgentResponseUpdate Outer, ChatResponseUpdate Raw, FunctionCallContent Call) Source()
{

    return (new AgentResponseUpdate(raw) { AgentId = "agent" }, raw, call);
}
var source = Source();
var beforeOuter = JsonSerializer.Serialize(source.Outer); var beforeRaw = JsonSerializer.Serialize(source.Raw);

Check(result.AuthorName == source.Outer.AuthorName && result.AgentId == source.Outer.AgentId && result.ResponseId == source.Outer.ResponseId && result.MessageId == source.Outer.MessageId && result.CreatedAt == source.Outer.CreatedAt && result.FinishReason == source.Outer.FinishReason && result.ContinuationToken == source.Outer.ContinuationToken, "Every supported outer property must survive projection.");

string MappingSnapshot(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(messages.Select(message => new { message.Role, message.MessageId, Contents = message.Contents.Select(content => new { Type = content.GetType().FullName, Json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(content, content.GetType()) }) }));
foreach (var scenario in new[] { "unknown-separate", "known-parent", "known-index", "different-parents", "repeated-parent-index", "reversed-parent-index", "repeated-known-index", "unknown-moved-calls" })
{
    NativeRequestLocation First() => scenario switch
    {
        "unknown-separate" or "unknown-moved-calls" => new(null, null, 0),
        "known-index" or "repeated-known-index" => new(null, 7, 0),
        "reversed-parent-index" => new("parent", null, 1),
        _ => new("parent", null, 0)
    };
    NativeRequestLocation Second() => scenario switch
    {
        "unknown-separate" or "unknown-moved-calls" => new(null, null, 0),
        "known-index" => new(null, 7, 1),
        "repeated-known-index" => new(null, 7, 0),
        "different-parents" => new("other-parent", null, 0),
        "repeated-parent-index" or "reversed-parent-index" => new("parent", null, 0),
        _ => new("parent", null, 1)
    };
    var descriptors = new[] {
        new NativeApprovalDescriptor("request-a", new("call-a", "backend", 1, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { code = "A" })), First()),
        new NativeApprovalDescriptor("request-b", new("call-b", "backend", 1, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { code = "B" })), Second())
    };
    var batch = new NativeBoundApprovalBatch(new("batch", descriptors, []), new Dictionary<string, NativePublicCallLocation> { ["request-a"] = new("assistant-call-a", 0, 0), ["request-b"] = new("assistant-call-b", 1, 0) });
    var ownedKey = new NativeSessionKey("native", "owned", "mapping", new Dictionary<string, string> { ["isolation"] = "owned" });
    var decisions = descriptors.Select(item => new NativeApprovalDecision(item.RequestId, NativeApprovalDecisionKind.Approved)).ToArray();
    var evidence = new NativeApprovalEvidence(ownedKey.Id, "adapter", registeredCatalog.Identity, new(ownedKey, "mapping-only", 2, 3), batch, 2, NativeApprovalState.DecisionAdmitted, decisions, 2, 3, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(1));
    var publicMessages = new JsonArray(descriptors.Select(item => (JsonNode?)new JsonObject { ["id"] = "assistant-" + item.Call.Id, ["role"] = "assistant", ["content"] = "", ["toolCalls"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["id"] = item.Call.Id, ["type"] = "function", ["function"] = new JsonObject { ["name"] = "backend", ["arguments"] = item.Call.Arguments.GetRawText() } }) }).ToArray());
    var raw = new JsonObject { ["threadId"] = "mapping", ["runId"] = "mapping", ["messages"] = publicMessages, ["tools"] = new JsonArray() }.ToJsonString();
    var input = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(raw, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput)!;
    var context = Activator.CreateInstance(contextType, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, [registration, new DefaultHttpContext(), input, "owned", "owned", raw, null, null, null], null)!;
    contextType.GetProperty("ApprovalEvidence", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(context, evidence);
    var converted = descriptors.Select(item => new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, [new FunctionCallContent(item.Call.Id, "backend", JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, object?>>(item.Call.Arguments))]) { MessageId = "assistant-" + item.Call.Id }).ToList();
    if (scenario == "unknown-moved-calls") converted.Reverse();
    converted.Add(new ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, decisions.Select(item => (AIContent)new InterruptResponseContent(item.RequestId) { Payload = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { approved = true }) }).ToList()));
    var before = MappingSnapshot(converted); var beforeLocations = JsonSerializer.Serialize(descriptors);
    var rejected = false; IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>? restored = null;

    try { restored = (IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>)restore.Invoke(null, [converted, context])!; }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejected = true; }

    var valid = scenario is "unknown-separate" or "known-parent" or "known-index" or "different-parents";
    Check(valid ? !rejected : rejected, "Restore distinguishes unknown separate native parents from proven same-group reversed/repeated positions and still rejects moved converted public calls: " + scenario);
    Check(MappingSnapshot(converted) == before && JsonSerializer.Serialize(descriptors) == beforeLocations, "Native Restore must not mutate public converted history or captured native locations: " + scenario);
    if (valid) Check(restored!.SelectMany(message => message.Contents).OfType<ToolApprovalRequestContent>().Select(item => ((FunctionCallContent)item.ToolCall).CallId).SequenceEqual(new[] { "call-a", "call-b" }), "Restoration replaces native approval requests in the original public sequence.");
    await ((IAsyncDisposable)context).DisposeAsync();
}

static async IAsyncEnumerable<AgentResponseUpdate> EmitBrowserEcho(FunctionResultContent result, string mutation, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken)
{
    await Task.CompletedTask;
    for (var index = 0; index < (mutation == "repeated-exact" ? 2 : 1); index++)
    {
        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var raw = new ChatResponseUpdate(ChatRole.Tool, [result]) { MessageId = "native-result-echo", ResponseId = "native-result-echo" };
        if (mutation == "enclosing-metadata") raw.AdditionalProperties = new() { ["meaningful"] = true };
        if (mutation == "continuation") raw.ContinuationToken = ResponseContinuationToken.FromBytes(new byte[] { 1 });
        yield return new AgentResponseUpdate(raw);
    }
}

        contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(echoContext, contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.GetValue(context));
        contextType.GetProperty("ApprovalEvidence", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(echoContext, contextType.GetProperty("ApprovalEvidence", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.GetValue(context));
        http.Items[contextType] = echoContext;
        var echoResult = new FunctionResultContent(resultMutation == "changed-id" ? "altered-browser" : "browser", resultMutation == "changed-result" ? "changed" : resultMutation == "tagged-result" ? (object)JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement("exact known browser result") : "exact known browser result");
        if (resultMutation == "annotations") echoResult.Annotations = [new CitationAnnotation()];
        if (resultMutation == "metadata") echoResult.AdditionalProperties = new() { ["meaningful"] = true };
        if (resultMutation == "raw") echoResult.RawRepresentation = new object();
        if (resultMutation == "exception") echoResult.Exception = new InvalidOperationException("meaningful");

        var echoInner = bare.AsBuilder().Use(null, (_, _, _, _, cancellation) => EmitBrowserEcho(echoResult, resultMutation, cancellation)).Build();
        var echoSession = await echoInner.CreateSessionAsync();
        contextType.GetMethod("Bind", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.Invoke(echoContext, [echoSession]);
        var echoAgent = (AIAgent)Activator.CreateInstance(restoreType, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, [echoInner, registeredCatalog, new HttpContextAccessor { HttpContext = http }, new AIFunction[] { backend }, null], null)!;

        var rejectedResult = false;

        try { await foreach (var update in echoAgent.RunStreamingAsync(converted, echoSession)) echoed.Add(update); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejectedResult = true; }

        var validEcho = resultMutation is "valid" or "repeated-exact";
        if (validEcho ? rejectedResult || echoed.Count != 0 || echoJournal.LegacySettlements != 0 : !rejectedResult) normalizationFailures.Add((mixed ? "mixed-result-echo:" : "browser-only-result-echo:") + resultMutation);
        contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(echoContext, null);
        await ((IAsyncDisposable)echoContext).DisposeAsync();
    }
    if (mixed && mutation == "valid")
    foreach (var heldMutation in new[] { "valid", "empty", "unknown-version", "hidden-protected", "duplicate", "message-id", "call-id", "argument-limit", "total-count", "total-bytes" })
    {

            ((System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary<string, (NativeToolCall Call, string Token, long Generation)>)contextType.GetField("_completedCurrentDispatches", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.GetValue(heldContext)!).TryAdd(heldCall.Id, (heldCall, lease.Token, lease.Generation));
            var rejectedLookalike = false;

            catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejectedLookalike = true; }

            foreach (var observationMutation in new[] { "custom-dictionary", "custom-comparer", "raw-conversation-single", "raw-conversation-grouped", "changed-name", "changed-arguments", "foreign-sibling", "wrong-marker", "call-annotations", "call-metadata", "call-raw", "outer-metadata", "mixed-text", "duplicate", "header-bound", "shared-byte-budget" })
            {

                observationArguments.Add("code", "held");

                if (observationMutation == "call-raw") heldObservation.RawRepresentation = new object();

                if (observationMutation == "mixed-text") calls.Add(new TextContent("unexplained sibling"));
                if (observationMutation == "raw-conversation-grouped") calls.Insert(0, new FunctionCallContent(nativeCall.Id, nativeCall.Name, JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, object?>>(nativeCall.Arguments.GetRawText())) { InformationalOnly = true });

                callbackReads = 0; comparatorArmed = true;

                try { contextType.GetMethod("ObserveHeldRecoveryCalls", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.Invoke(observationContext, [observation]); }
                catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejectedObservation = true; }

                var registry = contextType.GetField("_heldRecovery", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.GetValue(observationContext)!;

                if (!rejectedObservation || callbackReads != 0 || groups.Count != (observationMutation == "duplicate" ? 1 : 0)) normalizationFailures.Add("held-observer:" + observationMutation + ":rejected=" + rejectedObservation + ":callbacks=" + callbackReads + ":groups=" + groups.Count);
                contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(observationContext, null);
                await ((IAsyncDisposable)observationContext).DisposeAsync();
            }
            // Own-method boundary tests use synthetic completion only to exercise transitions, never real journal authority.
            var getterReads = 0;
            var snapshotHeld = contextType.GetMethod("SnapshotHeldRecoveryResult", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            var publishHeld = contextType.GetMethod("PublishHeldRecoveryResult", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            if (snapshotHeld is null || publishHeld is null) normalizationFailures.Add("held-result:separate-actual-return-lifecycle-missing");

                catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejectedGetter = true; }

                var rejectedBeforePublish = false;

                catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejectedBeforePublish = true; }

                publishHeld.Invoke(heldContext, [heldCall, staged]);
                foreach (var heldResultMutation in new[] { "changed", "tagged", "valid", "duplicate" })

                    var value = heldResultMutation == "changed" ? "changed" : heldResultMutation == "tagged" ? (object)JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement("actual held result") : "actual held result";
                    try { await (ValueTask)contextType.GetMethod("ObserveApprovalResultAsync", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.Invoke(heldContext, [new FunctionResultContent(heldCall.Id, value)])!; }
                    catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejectedOutward = true; }
                    if (rejectedOutward != (heldResultMutation != "valid")) normalizationFailures.Add("held-result:outward-" + heldResultMutation);
                }
                var manifest = contextType.GetMethod("ReadHeldRecoveryManifest", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.Invoke(heldContext, []);

        }
        contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(heldContext, null);
        await ((IAsyncDisposable)heldContext).DisposeAsync();
    }
    if (mixed && mutation == "valid")
    foreach (var kind in new[] { NativeApprovalDecisionKind.Declined, NativeApprovalDecisionKind.Cancelled })
    foreach (var rejectionMutation in new[] { "valid", "getter", "tagged-string", "wrong-string", "null", "ai-content", "journal-refusal", "duplicate" })
    {
        var getterReads = 0;
        var literal = kind == NativeApprovalDecisionKind.Declined ? "Tool call invocation rejected." : "Tool call invocation rejected. Cancelled by caller.";
        object? rejectedValue = rejectionMutation switch
        {

            "tagged-string" => JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(literal),

        }
        catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejectedObservation = true; }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejectedObservation = true; }

        var witnessed = ((System.Collections.IDictionary)contextType.GetField("_completedRecoveryResults", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.GetValue(rejectionContext)!).Count;
        var expectedSettlements = rejectionMutation is "valid" or "journal-refusal" or "duplicate" ? 1 : 0;
        var expectedWitnesses = rejectionMutation is "valid" or "duplicate" ? 1 : 0;
        if (getterReads != 0 || rejectionJournal.RejectionSettlements != expectedSettlements || witnessed != expectedWitnesses || rejectedObservation != (rejectionMutation != "valid")) normalizationFailures.Add(kind + ":rejection-" + rejectionMutation + ":getters=" + getterReads + ":settlements=" + rejectionJournal.RejectionSettlements + ":witnesses=" + witnessed);
        contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(rejectionContext, null);
        await ((IAsyncDisposable)rejectionContext).DisposeAsync();
    }
    if (mutation == "valid")
    {
        var validationCallbacks = 0;

    // Synthetic lower-layer witnesses are never released into journal cleanup or execution.
    contextType.GetProperty("Admission", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(context, null);
    await ((IAsyncDisposable)context).DisposeAsync();

Check(normalizationFailures.Count == 0, "Recovery normalization/owned echo must fail closed before native/provider work: " + string.Join(", ", normalizationFailures));

// Pure codec boundaries supplement the real public-route result fixtures without executing a handler or serializer callback.
var resultSnapshotType = restoreType.Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeBrowserRecoveryResultSnapshot")!;
var snapshotResult = resultSnapshotType.GetMethod("Create", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
var matchesResult = resultSnapshotType.GetMethod("Matches", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
var exactUtf8Result = "é \"quoted\" \\ line\n";
var exactUtf8Bytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(exactUtf8Result);
foreach (var limit in new[] { exactUtf8Bytes, exactUtf8Bytes - 1 })
{
    var refused = false; object? snapshot = null;

    try { snapshot = snapshotResult.Invoke(null, [exactUtf8Result, limit]); }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { refused = true; }

    Check(refused == (limit < exactUtf8Bytes), "Result witnesses enforce actual UTF-8 exact and one-byte-under boundaries.");
    if (!refused) Check((bool)matchesResult.Invoke(snapshot, [exactUtf8Result])!, "A within-bound immutable CLR string remains exact.");
}
foreach (var depth in new[] { 64, 65 })
{
    using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(new string('[', depth) + "0" + new string(']', depth), new JsonDocumentOptions { MaxDepth = 128 });
    var refused = false;

    try { snapshotResult.Invoke(null, [document.RootElement, 1024]); }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { refused = true; }

    Check(refused == (depth > 64), "Result witnesses enforce exact JSON depth64 versus65 without serializing custom objects.");
}
using (var jsonNullDocument = JsonDocument.Parse("null"))
{
    var jsonNullSnapshot = snapshotResult.Invoke(null, [jsonNullDocument.RootElement, 1024])!;
    var nullReturnSnapshot = snapshotResult.Invoke(null, [null, 1024])!;

    Check((bool)matchesResult.Invoke(jsonNullSnapshot, [jsonNullDocument.RootElement])! && !(bool)matchesResult.Invoke(jsonNullSnapshot, ["null"])!, "JsonElement null retains its native type tag rather than becoming a CLR string.");
    Check((bool)matchesResult.Invoke(nullReturnSnapshot, ["Success: Function completed."])! && !(bool)matchesResult.Invoke(nullReturnSnapshot, [jsonNullDocument.RootElement])!, "True null return requires the independently characterized native success sentinel.");
}

var unleasedAgent = NativeSessionAgentFactory.Create(new NeverModel(), "native", [backend], registeredCatalog, new HttpContextAccessor());
var unleasedCreateRejected = false;

try { await unleasedAgent.CreateSessionAsync(); }
catch (InvalidOperationException) { unleasedCreateRejected = true; }

Check(unleasedCreateRejected, "Actual native session creation must not bypass successful actual-key journal admission.");
Console.WriteLine("Native approval adapter projection passed.");

sealed class NeverModel : IChatClient
{
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new Exception("Preparation cannot invoke the model.");
    public IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new Exception("Preparation cannot invoke the model.");
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}

/// <summary>Counts forbidden legacy settlement calls in an explicitly synthetic own-bridge echo test; never grants durable authority.</summary>
public class BrowserEchoJournal : DispatchProxy
{
    public int LegacySettlements { get; private set; }
    public int RejectionSettlements { get; private set; }
    public bool RefuseRejection { get; set; }
    protected override object? Invoke(MethodInfo? method, object?[]? arguments)
    {
        if (method!.Name == nameof(INativeSessionJournal.SettleBrowserBypassResultAsync)) { LegacySettlements++; return ValueTask.FromResult(false); }
        if (method.Name == nameof(INativeSessionJournal.SettleApprovalRejectionAsync)) { RejectionSettlements++; return ValueTask.FromResult(!RefuseRejection); }
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Synthetic echo must not access journal method: " + method.Name);
    }
}

sealed class RejectedResultGetter(Action read)
{
    public string Value { get { read(); return "unsupported native rejection object"; } }
}

/// <summary>Uncharacterized dictionary whose interface reads must never run at the ordering observer.</summary>
sealed class HeldCallbackDictionary(Action callback) : Dictionary<string, object?>, IDictionary<string, object?>
{
    int ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, object?>>.Count { get { callback(); return Count; } }
    bool IDictionary<string, object?>.TryGetValue(string key, out object? value) { callback(); return TryGetValue(key, out value); }
}
/// <summary>Armed application comparer exposes otherwise hidden dictionary lookup callbacks.</summary>
sealed class HeldCallbackComparer(Action callback) : IEqualityComparer<string>
{
    public bool Equals(string? left, string? right) { callback(); return StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(left, right); }
    public int GetHashCode(string value) { callback(); return StringComparer.Ordinal.GetHashCode(value); }
}
